caption: The drawing shows a black and white pencil rendering of a metal object with three legs, resembling a fireplace andiron or similar support. The main object is positioned on the right side and features a vertical post with a faceted, square-shaped top, supported by two curved legs that extend outward and one horizontal support projecting backward. The base of each leg is flat. On the left side, a technical front elevation view of the object is included, showing a symmetrical U-shaped base with measurements below in inches marked from 0" to 3". The color of the drawing is monochromatic, primarily shades of gray created by pencil on a light beige or off-white paper. The entire composition is contained within a rectangular border, and there is a signature in the lower right corner that reads "J. Shaloff."
title: Andiron (one of pair)
